summary: W19 — the added Build load week (Adj #204) and the last full week before the W20 deload. Three of five sessions banked. Wednesday's §10 cut-down is the headline and it PASSED: 8:22 RPE 4 / 7:43 RPE 7 / 6:51 RPE 9, with the goal-pace mile 4 s/mi faster than 6:55 at RPE 9 — inside the 8–9 pass band, so Tier C sub-21:30 is confirmed and the downgrade branch never fired (Adj #320). It also settled the T band at 7:40–7:45 with no recalc: mile 2's flat RPE 7 is the first T read of the Build to sit ON the ≤7 anchor rather than under it, and it came pre-fatigued as rep 2 of the cut-down. With I confirmed at the W18 8×800m (Adj #296), both pace questions the Build has carried since W15 are now shut (Adj #321). The gap is unchanged and on the record: Riegel off the final mile puts the 5K equivalent at ~22:47, within 4 s of the W14 3K's 22:43, so ~75–80 s separates current fitness from the goal — Sharpen's job, arbitrated next at the W23 tune-up (Fri 9-25, target 22:00–22:15). Monday's long was banked but under-filled at 60:00 against the 70-min ask (Adj #309), so the week lands ~24 mi; the standing Achilles read at ~40 h closed clean and the calf holds 365 (Adj #310). Tuesday was the best accessory session of the Build — the rope pushdown's drop to 47.5 produced its first completed 4×12 and cleared the set-3 condition (Adj #315), and the DB lateral and Tue crunch both met their gates, with 40 and +15 held to W21 past the deload (Adj #313/#317). The incline stalled a second week at 160 and its linear progression is called at its ceiling (Adj #312). Remaining: Fri 5×1000m @ I opened at 7:00 with 90 s jog recoveries, and Sat Hyp B, where lat 170 fires and the Sat DB lateral reverts to 35.
